title: To Kill a Mockingbird
author: Harper Lee
description: A novel exploring themes of racial injustice and the loss of innocence in the American South, viewed through the eyes of young Scout Finch.

author: George Orwell
description: A chilling prophecy of a totalitarian future, where Big Brother exerts total control over every aspect of life and thought.

title: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
description: A classic portrait of the Jazz Age, exploring themes of wealth, idealism, social upheaval, and the elusive nature of the American Dream.

title: Dune
author: Frank Herbert
description: A sweeping science fiction epic set on the desert planet of Arrakis, dealing with themes of politics, religion, ecology, and human evolution.

title: The Hobbit
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
description: The beloved fantasy adventure of Bilbo Baggins as he is swept into a quest to reclaim a treasure guarded by the dragon Smaug.

title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
description: A sparkling romantic comedy centering on the turbulent relationship between Elizabeth Bennet and the proud Mr. Darcy.
